common.tagline: Practice naming with real open-source code

home.heading: Choosing good names takes time but saves more than it takes.
home.empty: No questions are playable yet. Approve some in the review screen.
home.pendingNotice: Development mode: unreviewed questions are shown too. Set NAMEKATA_ALLOW_PENDING=0 in production.

play.heading: What was this called?
play.instruction: Read what the code does and type your name straight into the blank. Its width is the length of the original name.
play.invalid: Use a valid identifier (letters, digits, _ or $).
play.commentUsed: The original comment is back where it was. Points deducted.
play.modified: Modified for this exercise: identifiers masked
play.spoiler: Opening the original reveals the answer
play.spoilerConfirm: This reveals the answer. Open anyway?
play.exactRateHint: Share of {count} submissions that matched the original exactly.

result.heading: Result
result.revealed: You revealed the answer. Nothing was submitted for this question.
result.wordNote: There is no single right name. The original is a reference, not an answer key.
result.othersEmpty: No other answers yet — yours is the first.

license.heading: Licenses and attribution
license.intro: namekata builds its questions from permissively licensed open-source code. Only MIT, BSD and Apache 2.0 code is used, and every question shows its repository, file, commit hash, license and copyright notice.
license.modifiedBody: To turn code into a question, identifier names are masked and comments and descriptive strings are removed. The code shown is not the original.
license.endorsementBody: Project names appear here as attribution only. They do not imply that those projects endorse or sponsor namekata.
license.takedownNote: If you do not want your code hosted here, use the takedown form and it will be removed.

takedown.heading: Takedown request
takedown.body: If you are a copyright holder or maintainer and do not want a piece of code hosted here, let us know. Include the question URL or the repository and file path and it will be removed.
takedown.privacyBody: Personal data such as commit author emails is never collected or stored.

admin.heading: Question review
admin.lede: Candidates that passed the automatic filters. Approve the ones that work as questions.
